decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a durable, high-capacity backpack suitable for multi-day use or heavy travel. I evaluated the Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) but was concerned by multiple reports of shoulder straps failing early on. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is a great value for a packable daypack, but too thin for serious use. Specialized options like the DeMarini baseball pack (prod_backpacks_122) and the TULYKA hydration pack (prod_backpacks_004) were too niche for general utility. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out for its high rating of 4.7, ample storage capacity, Molle compatibility, and strong customer feedback regarding durability and organization at a very competitive price of $39.99.
